name: waitroom
description: Mods that make the wait on a coding agent worth something.

plugins.name: waitroom
plugins.description: Installs the four rooms: wait-review, bet-on-your-agent, wait-ship, and wait-breathe. Optional — not in the four-room install: claude plugin install wait-changed@waitroom (turn-end file list), claude plugin install wait-ping@waitroom (local OS notification when a long turn ends or a permission confirm is waiting), claude plugin install wait-scope@waitroom (warns when a turn edits outside the scope you set).

plugins.name: wait-review
plugins.description: Turns the wait while Claude works into incremental review of the diff it already wrote.

plugins.name: bet-on-your-agent
plugins.description: Forecast how a turn will go from the row above the prompt, and get scored on your calibration.

plugins.name: wait-ship
plugins.description: Drafts the commit message, PR description and changelog entry for the turn's changes, so you can review the words the way wait-review lets you review the code.

plugins.name: wait-breathe
plugins.description: Shows one quiet nudge in the row above the prompt once a turn runs long — off by default until you turn it on.

plugins.name: wait-changed
plugins.description: After a Claude Code turn ends, shows a read-only list of the files that turn changed. On until you turn it off.

plugins.name: wait-ping
plugins.description: Sends a local OS notification when a long turn ends or a permission confirm is waiting. Sound stays off until you turn it on.

plugins.name: wait-scope
plugins.description: Warns when a Claude Code turn edits files outside the scope you set: a short count on the status line, then a list once the turn ends. Never blocks or reverts an edit.
